name: Kabei Yuzu
source:
"But don't worry, I won't put a hand on you anymore."

A dancer who dances at 'Dance Trips'.
He has the greatest skill and ability at dancing out of everybody at Dance Trips.
The princely type who is good at getting close to people, but he is emotionally unstable and will suddenly push people away once they reach a certain limit.
It seems the waiter Natsu knows something about his past.
